title: Understanding L2 Regularization
text: L2 regularization, also known as Ridge Regression, adds a penalty equal to the square of the magnitude of coefficients to the loss function. This helps in reducing overfitting by discouraging overly complex models.

title: Effect on Model Variance
text: When you apply L2 regularization, it tends to shrink the coefficients of the model. This can lead to a reduction in model variance, as the model becomes less sensitive to small fluctuations in the training data.

title: Impact on Training Set
text: What happens to the model's complexity when L2 regularization is applied?
choices: The model's complexity remains the same.

title: Regularization and Overfitting
text: How does L2 regularization affect overfitting?
choices: It has no effect on overfitting.
